environment_vars.description: List of environment variable strings (KEY=VALUE) to pass to the podman engine.

service_destinations.description: List of remote connection configurations for engine.service_destinations in containers.conf.

service_destinations.items.description: Placeholder for items structure. See items fields below.

service_destinations.scheme.description: URL scheme: ssh, tcp, or unix.

service_destinations.port.description: Remote port (22 for ssh/tcp by default).

service_destinations.path.description: Path to the podman socket file on the remote host.

service_destinations.identity.description: Path to the SSH identity file (private key).

service_destinations.proxy.description: SOCKS proxy URI (e.g. socks5://user:pass@host:port) for TCP connections.
